name: Docker images
client: Docker CLI/daemon supplied by the CI runner; crane 0.22.1
auth: READ permission is required to resolve metadata and bytes; DEPLOY is additionally required to publish. Supply an unexpired Access token in AW_TOKEN; Basic authentication uses AW_USER matching the token subject. Token scope must retain the repository permissions; a token cannot grant access that its principal lacks.
fresh_home: Use fresh DOCKER_CONFIG. For a cold pull use a disposable Docker daemon or remove only the test image from that daemon after push; a fresh CLI config alone does not empty daemon layers.
prerequisites: A Docker daemon that can reach the registry HTTPS origin.
A build context image/ with Dockerfile and application content.

configure.code:
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
export DOCKER_CONFIG="$AW_WORK/docker"
mkdir -p "$DOCKER_CONFIG"
AW_REGISTRY="${AW_URL#*://}"
configure.note: Registry authority includes a port when needed. AW_URL must be a bare HTTPS origin, with no path. Configuration files remain under AW_WORK.

publish.note: Publish to a concrete local or one-node federated target.

steps.code:
docker buildx build --load --platform linux/amd64 --provenance=false --sbom=false -t "$AW_REGISTRY/$AW_REPO/team/app:v1" image
docker push "$AW_REGISTRY/$AW_REPO/team/app:v1"

install.note: Pull uses the repository key as the first image-name component.

limitations: Registry client URLs omit /artifactory; the discovery endpoint is /v2/.
Changing tag contents can require DELETE permission under strict tag overwrite.
Docker itself is runner-provided, not a pinned released archive. The separately pinned crane/ORAS lanes supply stable registry-client evidence.

contains: docker builds, pushes and pulls an image
The version probe challenges an anonymous client
A remote Docker repository refuses client writes
password (the user name must be the token's subject)
